product: Upcoming deprecation of the data quality monitoring downstream_impact column
tagline: The downstream impact column in the data quality monitoring results system table is being deprecated.
what_it_does: The downstream impact column in the data quality monitoring results system table is being deprecated. Deprecation begins September 7, 2026, and rolls out gradually across regions over the following week. Until the rollout reaches your workspace, you might still be able to query downstream impact.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
